note: Machine-readable acceptance cases for tools/issue_intake.py. Load this file in tests/test_issue_intake.py, build the fetch result from each case's `issues` array, apply the constant config (MAX_PICKS from the case, default 2), and assert `picked` and `skipped` exactly. Bodies are abridged from the live repository; the structural lines are verbatim. `state` maps issue number (string) to the state-file entry that already exists.
